_comment: Template for manual reaction data curation. One entry per reaction condition set.

fields.DOI: Digital Object Identifier of the source paper
fields.Title: Full paper title
fields.Metal_catalyst: Metal complex used, e.g. FeCl2, Fe(OAc)2, CoBr2
fields.Ligand: Chiral ligand name or abbreviation, e.g. (R)-BINAP, Josiphos
fields.Substrate_class: Substrate type, e.g. aryl ketone, cyclic imine, enamide
fields.H2_pressure_bar: H2 pressure in bar, number only
fields.Temperature_C: Reaction temperature in Celsius, number only
fields.Reaction_time_h: Reaction time in hours, number only
fields.TOF: Turnover frequency in h^-1, number only
fields.Notes: Free-text notes, caveats, or manual corrections
fields.Evidence_sentence: Sentence from PDF where data was found
fields.Page_number: Page(s) in PDF where data was found
fields.PDF_path: Local path to the source PDF

example_entry.Title: Relay Iron/Chiral Brønsted Acid Catalysis: Enantioselective Hydrogenation of Benzoxazinones
example_entry.Authors: Liang-Qiu Lu; Yuehui Li; Kathrin Junge; Matthias Beller
example_entry.Journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
example_entry.Notes: Relay catalysis with chiral phosphoric acid co-catalyst
